verdict.rationale: Paystack's own marketing says it supports reconciliation through a data Dashboard with exports, and lets users retrieve transaction data, so a first-party reconciliation capability exists. Nothing documents how it works in depth: there is no evidence of settlement-to-bank-deposit matching or of itemized fee, refund or chargeback breakdowns. Missing for 10: settlement/payout reports tied to bank deposits, itemized fee breakdowns, refund and chargeback line items in reports, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks

citations.quote: do easy reconciliations with a robust data Dashboard and easy exports
